Description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend The Opportunity: Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Bonus Points For Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems. Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions. Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products. Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations. Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product. Compensation & Rewards: In Ireland, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 133,600- EUR 160,320. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs ' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs : 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Description: About Us Zoo is building the next generation of hardware design tools redefining how hardware products are designed, developed, and built. Our platform combines a modern, cloud-native CAD environment with AI-powered engineering workflows, helping teams design, iterate, and manufacture products faster than ever before. We are headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with both a local and remote team. We were founded and incubated by Embedded Ventures in 2021. About You We’re looking for curious, innovative, and ambitious self-starters to join our growing team to help us bring our mission to life. We think you’ll thrive on our team if you’re: Curious at your core, with an eagerness to learn and do things differently Customer-focused, always thinking about ways to improve the user experience Able to operate autonomously and work asynchronously, while also being an effective team player About The Role As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Zoo, you'll play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of our novel open-source CAD modeling app, Zoo Design Studio. This unique, DSL-driven application leverages traditional CAD UI for code generation/editing while streaming a 3D scene from our remote graphics engine. This is a "back of the front-end" role, where your efforts will be instrumental in creating and gluing features together from our UI that drives DSL code-mods, triggering executions with our Rust/Wasm DSL, or interfacing with our backend's WebSocket API and doing so in an extensible way. We're looking for a seasoned Engineer with substantial experience building highly performant, scalable web applications with a deep understanding of performance optimization techniques. This is an awesome opportunity to significantly impact one of our core products during this critical phase of growth for our team. What You’ll Do Develop and optimize the frontend of our modeling app, focusing on performance and user experience Collaborate with backend teams to design and implement robust APIs that support the app's code-driven design functionality Enhance the app's UI/UX by leveraging Typescript, React, and XState, ensuring that the interface is both powerful and easy to use Develop delightful CodeMirror extensions that bridge the gap between the user's code and the 3d-model Implement advanced AST/code-mods, CodeMirror enhancements, and deep integration with WebAssembly (Wasm) for performance improvements Utilize Xstate for state management to maintain app consistency and reliability across various user interactions Apply a deep understanding of JavaScript and browser internals to improve app functionality and performance What You’ll Need B.S. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience Substantial experience in frontend software development building complex, highly performant and scalable applications Strong proficiency in Typescript and React, with a portfolio or examples of complex applications built using these technologies Deep knowledge of JavaScript and its internal workings and performance optimization techniques Familiarity with WebAssembly (Wasm) and its use in web applications for performance enhancements Understanding of browser internals across major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Chromium, Brave, etc.) and their impact on application performance and compatibility Knowledge of Xstate or similar state management libraries Nice to Have Proficiency with Rust Experience with CodeMirror6 Experience with ASTs even if custom ESLint rules Experience with WebGL or web graphics A background in geometry and/or experience with design-based software The salary range for this role is provided below. Description: Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/x) Location: EU/UK (Remote) Who You’ll Work For: At Makersite , we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. Who we're looking for: As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Frontend Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location. The role: Frontend Feature Development: Design, develop and maintain frontend features and functionalities across the company's platform, delivering intuitive and reliable user experiences. Angular Ownership: Take ownership of the Angular codebase, driving its ongoing development, maintenance and technical direction. Frontend Architecture & Standards: Lead frontend architectural decisions and establish scalable patterns, reusable components and consistent development practices. Design Systems & Component Libraries: Develop and maintain shared UI components and design systems to improve consistency, accessibility and development efficiency across the platform. Testing & Code Quality: Implement automated tests, including unit, integration and end-to-end testing, to ensure application reliability and maintainability. Performance & Maintenance: Investigate and resolve bugs, optimise frontend performance and continuously improve existing functionality. Product Collaboration: Work closely with the Product Owner and engineering team to translate product requirements and domain logic into clear technical solutions. Cross-Functional Delivery: Contribute to product development across different areas of the business, collaborating with backend and frontend engineers to deliver agreed roadmap priorities. Technical Problem-Solving: Navigate an evolving codebase, investigate existing implementations and work independently to solve complex technical and product challenges. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, technical practices and the overall quality and scalability of the platform. Requirements Frontend Development: Several years of professional frontend development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Angular, preferably version 17 or later. Angular Expertise: Comfortable working with the Angular Signals API, RxJS and observable patterns, and modern Angular development practices. Frontend Architecture: Experience making frontend architectural decisions, establishing coding standards and maintaining scalable, maintainable applications. Component Libraries & Design Systems: Experience building and maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries, including applying smart/dumb component patterns. Reusable & Accessible Components: Experience building accessible, reusable UI components using Angular Material or equivalent component libraries. Automated Testing: Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including hands-on experience with Playwright. Product Engineering: Ability to translate product requirements and domain logic into effective user experiences and reliable functionality. Independent Delivery: Self-directed and delivery-focused, able to manage workload independently and take ownership of features from implementation through to release. Problem-Solving & Quality: Strong debugging skills, attention to detail and the ability to resolve bugs, improve performance and maintain code quality. Communication & Collaboration: Clear communicator who works effectively with product owners, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders. Legally permitted to work within the EU or UK. Desirable Skills & Experience Java & Spring: Experience with Java and Spring, particularly when working across frontend and backend boundaries, is a significant advantage. Enterprise SaaS: Experience building B2B enterprise applications, including complex forms, data grids, role-based access and multi-tenant environments. AI-Assisted Development: Interest in and experience using AI-assisted development tools and workflows. Product Team Experience: Experience working in small, autonomous engineering teams within a fast-paced scale-up environment. Domain Knowledge: An interest in sustainability, carbon footprint data or industrial data exchange is beneficial. Experience using Storybook and collaborating with UX teams through Figma Experience using OpenAPI-generated types and contract-first API development approaches What We Offer: Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, and the UK, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. The Experience: Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.
